bio: Suzanne J. Cooper is the Academic Dean for Teaching and Curriculum and the Edith M. Stokey Senior Lecturer in Public Policy. As the ADTC, she is responsible for all aspects of the Kennedy School’s teaching mission and works on a broad range of academic and faculty issues, including Educational Technology and the SLATE (Strengthen Learning and Teaching Excellence) program.
